assertions.assertion: Mentions that ACS URLs must use HTTP-POST binding (HTTP-Redirect is not supported for ACS)
assertions.rationale: Response explicitly states 'every entry must use SamlBinding.HttpPost. HTTP-Redirect is not supported for ACS and will fail validation' and marks it as a common mistake.

assertions.assertion: States that AllowedScopes must contain at least one entry
assertions.rationale: Section '3. At Least One AllowedScopes Entry' states 'The AllowedScopes collection must be non-empty' and the checklist confirms '≥1 AllowedScopes'.
Section '1. EntityId — Required, Non-Empty' explicitly states 'The SP entity ID must be a non-empty string'.

assertions.assertion: Explains that invalid SPs are treated as non-existent (returns null from store)
assertions.rationale: The Background section states 'Any SP that fails validation is treated as non-existent — requests from it will be rejected as if the SP were not registered at all'.
